Script.name: helpwin
Script.script:
--[[ Help window Sean Stoves, 2026-08-02
Help files out of the scrollback and into a panel that starts empty every time you read one, so the last thing you asked about is the only thing in front of you.
Aardwolf will mark its own help output if you ask it to. Telnet channel 102 carries the tag options, one byte for which and one for on/off:
IAC SB 102 <option> <1 on | 2 off> IAC SE
Option 3 is helpfiles. With it on, the MUD wraps replies in its tag protocol - {help}...{/help}, and {helpsearch}...{/helpsearch} for 'help search' - so there's nothing to scrape. Without it every help is a wall of dashes with no machine-readable start or end, and the dash count moves with your screen width.
Mudlet has sendTelnetChannel102() for the wrapper, so we only supply the two payload bytes.
The tag arrives before the first line and after the last, which is all the framing needed: clear on open, copy each line across, stop on close. Lines are copied with copy()/appendBuffer so the MUD's colours survive - the point is to read the file, not a plaintext rendering of it.
30_tags.lua owns the tag gag and would otherwise treat {help} as an unknown marker and delete the wrapper itself. Two owners deleting the same line is what left blank gaps in the room description, so help is in its OWNED set there and this file is the only thing that touches it. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.helpwin = aardkit.helpwin or {}
local HW = aardkit.helpwin local U = aardkit.util
local CFG = U.load("helpwin", { on = true, keep = false, -- append instead of starting fresh })
local panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "help", title = "Help", width = 700, height = 460, x = "120px", y = "60px", fontSize = 10, })
HW.panel = panel
--- -- asking the MUD to mark it ---
local HELPS_OPT = 3
-- Mudlet wraps this in IAC SB 102 ... IAC SE for us; the payload is the option -- and whether we want it. Wrapped because a Mudlet without it is a nil call, -- and a client that can't negotiate should still load the rest of the module. local function telopt(on) if not U.has("sendTelnetChannel102") then return false end return (pcall(sendTelnetChannel102, string.char(HELPS_OPT, on and 1 or 2))) end
function HW.negotiate() if not CFG.on then return end -- The MUD forgets between sessions, so this goes out on every connect. telopt(true) end
--- -- capture ---
local capturing, trig, timer
local function stop() if trig then pcall(killTrigger, trig); trig = nil end if timer then pcall(killTimer, timer); timer = nil end capturing = nil end
-- Armed on the open tag and killed on the close, rather than a permanent -- catch-all that tests a flag on every line of the session. The closing tag is -- recognised in here too: a second trigger for it would race this one, and -- whichever fired first would delete the line out from under the other. local function arm(kind) trig = tempRegexTrigger([[^.*$]], function() local line = getCurrentLine() or "" if line:match("^%s*{/help") then U.gag() stop() return end panel:capture_line() U.gag() end) -- A help that never closes would eat the rest of the session. timer = tempTimer(15, function() if capturing then stop() U.warn("Help: no closing tag arrived - stopped capturing.") end end) capturing = kind end
function HW.on_open(kind) if not CFG.on then return end stop() U.gag() if not CFG.keep then panel:clear() end panel:show() arm(kind or "help") end
-- 'help search' with no matches, and a bad keyword, both come back inside the -- tags, so they land in the panel like anything else and there's nothing -- special to do about them.
--- -- commands ---
function HW.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg) rest = U.trim(rest):lower()
if verb == "" then panel:toggle()
elseif verb == "on" or verb == "off" then CFG.on = (verb == "on") U.save("helpwin", CFG) telopt(CFG.on) if not CFG.on then stop() end U.ok("Help window " .. verb .. (CFG.on and " - help goes to the panel." or " - help stays in the main window."))
elseif verb == "keep" then CFG.keep = not CFG.keep U.save("helpwin", CFG) U.ok("Help window: " .. (CFG.keep and "keeping previous helps." or "fresh every time."))
elseif verb == "clear" then panel:clear() U.ok("Help window cleared.")
elseif verb == "retry" or verb == "negotiate" then if telopt(true) then U.ok("Asked the MUD to tag help output again.") else U.warn("This Mudlet has no sendTelnetChannel102 - can't negotiate.") end
elseif verb == "dock" or verb == "embed" or verb == "show" or verb == "hide" then aardkit.panel.cmd("help " .. verb)
else U.help("Help window", { { "state", CFG.on and "on" or "off" }, { "on open", CFG.keep and "appends" or "starts fresh" }, { "tagging", U.has("sendTelnetChannel102") and "negotiated on connect" or "unavailable in this Mudlet" }, { "" }, { "helpwin", "show or hide the panel" }, { "helpwin on | off", "capture help, or leave it in the main window" }, { "helpwin keep", "append rather than starting fresh" }, { "helpwin clear", "empty it" }, { "helpwin retry", "ask the MUD to tag help output again" }, { "helpwin dock | embed | show | hide", "panel placement" }, { "" }, { "Read help as you always have - 'help <topic>'. Aardwolf marks" }, { "the reply and it lands here instead of the scrollback." }, }) end end
aardkit.register("helpwin", "help files in their own panel, fresh each read", HW.cmd)
U.killhandler(aardkit_helpwin_connect) aardkit_helpwin_connect = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", function() stop() -- the MUD isn't listening the instant the socket opens tempTimer(2, HW.negotiate) end)
HW.negotiate()
